license_verification.result: No open license, no research-only-with-a-named-license tag, and no explicit redistribution statement found for the EnDive dialect-translated text at any source checked. Staged as metadata-only rather than guessed in either direction, per this repo's rule 2.

coverage: Zero dialect-translated rows staged (0% of the ~35,614 dialect-translated rows counted across the 12 dialect-split task repos' own published per-split example counts, and 0% of NovelHopQA's 4,345 rows, which use a different hop_1..hop_4 split scheme with no dialect column observed in its own published schema). Per dialect, 0 of an estimated 7,273 (AAVE), 4,118 (IndE), 8,192 (JamE), 8,074 (CollSgE), and 7,957 (ChcE) rows across the 12 dialect-split repos were fetched -- all five dialect counts are read from each repo's own published `dataset_info.splits` metadata, not from downloading or reading any row. What is staged instead is 100% of what this pass judged safely redistributable at the current, undetermined licensing status: an original, fully-sourced description of the dataset's construction, methodology, per-repo schema, and per-dialect row counts (metadata only), plus the license-verification record above.
